NONE: › abbreviation for
technical
› abbreviation for
technology
› someone who knows a lot about computers or other electronic equipment
技術人員；科技迷；（尤指）電腦通，電腦迷
B2 relating to the knowledge, machines, or methods used in science and industry
技術的
› relating to the knowledge and methods of a particular subject or job
專門性的
B2 relating to practical skills and methods that are used in a particular activity
技能的，技巧的

example: a few technical problems
幾個技術問題
Personally, I found some parts of the book a little too technical to follow.
我個人認為，書中有些部分過於專業化，一般人不易看懂。
In her performance as the Snow Queen she showed great technical brilliance.
她演冰雪女王時表現出了高超的演技。

NONE: › an area by the side of a football pitch where a manager, coaches, and substitutes sit during a game, with an area marked by white lines where a team's manager can stand to give instructions to the team
技術區（足球場地邊的一塊區域，比賽期間球隊的教練、訓練人員和替補隊員在這裡入座，在其中一塊由白線標出的區域內，球隊教練可在此指揮比賽）

example: Wenger was ordered out of the technical area for the second half.
溫格被下令下半場不得進入技術區。

NONE: › a school where students learn skills that involve working with their hands
技術學校

example: Compare
trade school

NONE: › an advice service provided, usually over the phone, to help people who have problems using a computer
（有關如何使用電腦的）技術支援

example: We had to make five calls to technical support to get the computer working.
我們給技術支援部門打了五次電話才把電腦弄好。

NONE: › a detail or small matter
細則，細節，小事

example: He was disqualified from the competition on a technicality.
他因為違反技術細則而被取消了參賽資格。

NONE: C2 according to an exact understanding of rules, facts, etc.
事實上，嚴格說來
C1 in a way that relates to the knowledge, machines, or methods used in science and industry
在技術上，技術性能方面
› in a way that relates to practical skills and methods that are used in a particular activity
在工藝技巧上；在專業上

example: Technically, the country's economic problems are over, but recovery will be slow.
理論上，這個國家的經濟問題已經消失了，但復甦將會很慢。
young people who are technically still children
實際上仍然是孩子的年青人
It was a technically brilliant performance.
從技藝的角度來看，這真是一場精湛的表演。

NONE: C1 a worker trained with special skills, especially in science or engineering
技術員，技師
› a person whose technique is very good
技藝精湛者，巧匠

example: a laboratory technician
實驗室技術員

NONE: › having a lot of bright colours
色彩鮮艷的，艷麗多彩的
› a brand name for a special process for making cinema films in colour
（電影的）彩色印片法
B1 a way of doing an activity that needs skill
技術，技能

example: We have developed a new technique for detecting errors in the manufacturing process.
我們開發了一項新技術，用於檢測生產流程中的錯誤。
She's a wonderfully creative dancer but she doesn't have the technique of a truly great performer.
她是個很有創造力的舞蹈演員，但她缺乏一個真正偉大的舞蹈家的技巧。

NONE: C1 fast electronic dance music with a regular beat
高技術音樂（一種節奏快而強勁的電子舞蹈音樂）
› relating to or involving technology
科技的；技術的；和科技（或技術）有關的

example: Thousands of ravers came to Berlin yesterday for the world's largest techno music party.
幾千名銳舞客昨天來到柏林，參加全球最大型的電子舞曲音樂派對。
a technophile (= a person who loves technology)
科技愛好者

NONE: › technical language that is difficult for ordinary people to understand
技術閒聊（普通人難於理解的技術語言）
› specialized politics a government or social system that is controlled or influenced by experts in science or technology; the fact of a government or social system being influenced by such experts
技術官僚主義

example: We live in a technocracy where progress involves the mastering of increasingly complex data.
我們生活在一個技術官僚主義時代，要取得進步就必須充分掌握日益複雜的資料。
In her opinion, technocracy was not incompatible with democracy.
在她看來，技術官僚主義與民主並不衝突。

NONE: › specialized politics an expert in science or technology who has a lot of power in or influence with the government or industry
技術官僚

example: We believe there is a danger in policy-makers blindly trusting the technocrats.
我們相信決策者盲目信任技術官僚是危險的。

NONE: B2 relating to, or involving, technology
技術的，關於（或涉及）技術的

example: Technological advances in computing and telecommunications have reduced the need for many people to travel to work.
隨著電腦及通訊技術的進步，許多人將不必再出門上班了。

NONE: › someone who works with a particular technology
技術專家；工藝師

example: an architectural technologist
一個建築學專家
a food technologist
一個食品專家

NONE: B1 (the study and knowledge of) the practical, especially industrial, use of scientific discoveries
技術（學）；應用技術；（尤指）工業技術

example: computer technology
電腦技術
Modern technology is amazing, isn't it?
現代技術很奇妙，是不是？
What this country needs is a long-term policy for investment in science and technology.
這個國家所需要的是科技投入方面的長期政策。
See also
biotechnology

NONE: › someone who dislikes new technology, especially computers, and is not able to use it with confidence
厭惡技術（尤指電腦技術）的人
› specialized geology relating to the structure of the surface of the earth and the way it is formed, changed, and moved by forces inside it
地殼構造的
› A tectonic change is a very important one that will have major effects.
非常重要的；具有重大影響的

example: the motion of the earth's tectonic plates (= sections of the planet's surface)
地球板塊的運動
He led the company through a period of tectonic shifts in the movie industry.
他領導公司度過了一段電影業發生了翻天覆地變化的時期。
The process of writing is in the midst of a tectonic change caused by changes in the technology writers use.
寫作過程正在經歷一場巨大變革，這是由作者們所使用的科技引發的。
